shared: Concept render for an interactive 3D personal website built in three.js. Stylised real-time 3D look: soft global illumination, gentle ambient occlusion, slightly chunky low-poly forms with bevelled edges, hand-painted textures, cosy indie-game feel. The collectible objects are: chunky plastic game cartridges in many colours with small illustrated labels; hardcover books and stitched notebooks; small square memory cards with gold contact strips; and an original orange handheld game console in LANDSCAPE orientation (wider than tall, screen in the centre, cross-shaped d-pad on the left, three small square cream buttons on the right, rounded chunky body, not resembling any real product). No readable text, no letters, no logos anywhere; any UI panels show only abstract grey lines and simple icons. No people.

concepts.name: The Observatory Study
concepts.idea: The 2 AM study moved to the top of a stone observatory tower above the clouds. Night sky, maths, and floating islands outside.
concepts.overview: Setting: a round study room at the top of a stone observatory tower high above a sea of clouds at night. A big brass telescope points through an open slit in the domed roof full of stars. Curved wooden bookshelves follow the round wall: one curved shelf holds a long row of colourful game cartridges, another holds books and notebooks, and a brass-bound cabinet of small drawers holds memory cards. A large desk in the centre with star charts, geometric sketches on graph paper, a twenty-sided die and the orange handheld console. Through tall arched windows, small floating islands with tiny lit houses drift in moonlight. Palette: deep indigo night, warm amber lamplight, brass, honey wood.
concepts.place: the round observatory study at night with the brass telescope, curved shelves and arched windows onto floating islands

concepts.name: The Airship Cabin
concepts.idea: The captain's cabin of a sky airship. The career is a voyage; islands drift past the windows as you scroll.
concepts.overview: Setting: the cosy wooden captain's cabin at the stern of a flying airship at sunset. A wide curved row of leaded windows at the back shows a pink and gold sky with floating rock islands and other small airships drifting by. Along the curved wooden walls: a bookshelf with a brass rail holding books and notebooks, a wide map-chest whose open top drawer is filled with colourful game cartridges standing in rows, and a wall-mounted rack of memory cards like a ship's logbook index. A chart table in the centre holds a hand-drawn sky map, a brass compass, a lantern and the orange handheld console. Ropes, brass pipes, a small ship's wheel. Palette: warm mahogany, brass, sunset peach and lavender sky.
concepts.place: the wooden captain's cabin of a flying airship at sunset, with curved leaded windows onto floating islands

concepts.name: The Treehouse Workshop
concepts.idea: A lantern-lit treehouse on a floating island at dusk. Each platform is a section, joined by rope bridges.
concepts.overview: Setting: a giant old tree growing on a small floating island above the clouds at dusk, seen from a three-quarter angle. Built into its branches is a cosy wooden treehouse workshop with several platforms joined by rope bridges and lanterns: one round platform is a little games room with shelves of colourful game cartridges, one is a tiny library hut with books and notebooks, and the highest is a small round vault with memory cards glowing in niches. On the main deck sits a workbench with tools, sketches and the orange handheld console. Fireflies, string lights, a small waterfall pouring off the island edge. Palette: dusky violet and teal sky, warm lantern orange, mossy greens, weathered wood.
concepts.place: the lantern-lit treehouse workshop in a giant tree on a floating island at dusk

concepts.name: The Pocket World
concepts.idea: The night study, but on the desk sits a glass dome holding a tiny floating island. Click it and you dive into the imaginary world.
concepts.overview: Setting: a cosy lamp-lit study at night, seen straight on. Behind the desk, a wooden wall shelf holds a row of colourful game cartridges on the top tier, books and notebooks on the middle tier, and a tray of memory cards on the bottom tier. The hero of the image is on the desk: a large glass dome, like a bell jar, containing a tiny floating island world with a crooked little tower, a waterfall, clouds and a miniature airship, softly glowing from inside. Next to the dome sits the orange handheld console, a twenty-sided die and graph-paper sketches. A brass desk lamp and a window with a crescent moon. Palette: honey wood, amber lamplight, deep navy night, and the dome's magical teal and peach glow.
concepts.place: the lamp-lit night study whose desk holds a glass dome containing a tiny floating island

views.name: Browsing projects
views.prompt: Show the same scene, same art style, lighting and objects as the reference image, but the camera has moved in close to the game cartridges in {place}. One cartridge has been pulled halfway out of its row and floats forward, glowing softly, tilted toward the viewer so its illustrated label is visible. Beside it floats a small semi-transparent rounded info panel (only abstract grey lines and two small icon buttons, no text). The other cartridges are slightly out of focus.

views.name: Playing a project
views.prompt: Show the same scene, same art style, lighting and objects as the reference image, but the camera is now close on the orange landscape handheld console in {place}. A colourful cartridge is pushed into the slot on top of the handheld. The handheld's screen is lit and shows a colourful painterly little game world (a crooked riverside town with red roofs). Small sparkles and a soft glow come from the screen. The background of the scene is softly blurred.

views.name: Reading and career
views.prompt: Show the same scene, same art style, lighting and objects as the reference image, but the camera now looks down at a reading moment in {place}: a book lies open with illustrated pages (sketches and diagrams, no text), and next to it a row of memory cards is laid out in a gently curving line like a path or timeline, each card with a tiny illustrated label, the last card glowing brightly as the current one. A notebook and pencil nearby.
